19.odr_com: His maister hearing these thinges, and geuing ouer light credite to his wiues wordes, was very wrath:
19.sabates_a: His master hearing these things, and giving over light credit to his wife's words, was very wrath:
19.madueke_b: His master hearing these things, and giving over light credit to his wife's words, was very wrath:

20.s_dismas: and deliuered Ioſeph into priſon, where the kinges priſoners were kept, and he was there ſhut vp.
20.odr_com: and deliuered Ioseph into prison, where the kinges prisoners were kept, and he was there shut vp.
20.sabates_a: and delivered Joseph into prison, where the king's prisoners were kept, and he was there shut up.
20.madueke_b: and delivered Joseph into prison, where the king's prisoners were kept, and he was there shut up.

21.s_dismas: And our Lord was with Ioſeph, and hauing mercie vpon him gaue him grace in the ſight of the chiefe of the priſon.
21.odr_com: And our Lord was with Ioseph, and hauing mercie vpon him gaue him grace in the sight of the chiefe of the prison.
21.sabates_a: And our Lord was with Joseph, and having mercy upon him gave him grace in the sight of the chief of the prison.
21.madueke_b: And our Lord was with Joseph, and having mercy upon him gave him grace in the sight of the chief of the prison.

22.s_dismas: Who deliuered in his hand al the priſoners that were kept in cuſtodie: and whatſoeuer was done, was vnder him.
22.odr_com: Who deliuered in his hand al the prisoners that were kept in custodie: and whatsoeuer was done, was vnder him.
22.sabates_a: Who delivered in his hand all the prisoners that were kept in custody: and whatsoever was done, was under him.
22.madueke_b: Who delivered in his hand all the prisoners that were kept in custody: and whatsoever was done, was under him.

23.s_dismas: Neyther did himſelfe knowe any thing, hauing committed al things to him: for our Lord was with him, and directed al his workes.
23.odr_com: Neyther did himselfe knowe any thing, hauing committed al things to him: for our Lord was with him, and directed al his workes.
23.sabates_a: Neither did himself know anything, having committed all things to him: for our Lord was with him, and directed all his works.
23.madueke_b: Neither did himself know anything, having committed all things to him: for our Lord was with him, and directed all his works.

janvier_by_verse.1: Therefore Joseph was brought into Ægypt, and Putiphar an Eunuch of Pharao, Prince of his army, a man of Ægypt bought him, at the hand of the Ismaelites, by whom he was brought.
janvier_by_verse.2: And our Lord was with him, and he was a man that in all things did prosperously: and he dwelt in his master's house,
janvier_by_verse.3: who knew very well that our Lord was with him, and that all things which he did were directed by him in his hand.
janvier_by_verse.4: And Joseph found grace before his master, and ministered to him: by whom being made ruler over all his things, he governed the house committed to him, and all things that were delivered unto him:
janvier_by_verse.5: and our Lord blessed the house of the Ægyptian for Joseph's sake, and multiplied as well in houses, as in lands all his substance.
janvier_by_verse.6: Neither knew he any other thing, but the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was of beautiful countenance, and comely favoured to behold.
janvier_by_verse.7: After many days therefore his Mistress cast her eyes on Joseph, and said: Sleep with me.
janvier_by_verse.8: Who in nowise assenting to that wicked act, said to her: Behold, my master having delivered all things unto me, knoweth not what he hath in his own house:
janvier_by_verse.9: Neither is there any thing which is not in my power, or that he hath not delivered to me, beside thee, that art his wife: how therefore can I do this wicked thing, and sin against my God?
janvier_by_verse.10: With these kind of words day by day both the woman was importune upon the young man, and he refused the adultery.
janvier_by_verse.11: And it chanced on a certain day, that Joseph went into the house, and did some business without any man with him:
janvier_by_verse.12: and she catching the skirt of his garment, said: Sleep with me. Who leaving the cloak in her hand, fled, and went forth abroad.
janvier_by_verse.13: And when the woman saw the garment in her hands, and herself to be contemned,
janvier_by_verse.14: she called to her the men of her house, and said to them: See he hath brought in an Hebrew to delude us: he came upon me for to lie with me; and when I had cried out,
janvier_by_verse.15: and he heard my voice, he left the cloak that I held, and fled forth.
janvier_by_verse.16: For an argument therefore of her credit she reserved the cloak, & shewed it to her husband returning home,
janvier_by_verse.17: and said: There came unto me the Hebrew servant, whom thou didst bring hither, for to delude me:
janvier_by_verse.18: and when he heard me cry, he left the cloak which I held, and fled forth.
janvier_by_verse.19: His master hearing these things, and giving over light credit to his wife's words, was very wrath:
janvier_by_verse.20: and delivered Joseph into prison, where the king's prisoners were kept, and he was there shut up.
janvier_by_verse.21: And our Lord was with Joseph, and having mercy upon him gave him grace in the sight of the chief of the prison.
janvier_by_verse.22: Who delivered in his hand all the prisoners that were kept in custody: and whatsoever was done, was under him.
janvier_by_verse.23: Neither did himself know anything, having committed all things to him: for our Lord was with him, and directed all his works.
